inputs: Blackout strategic guardrails and risk/mitigation policy
Mission to reduce user-perceived complexity with trust primitives preserved
Required output format and onboarding/navigation/progressive disclosure constraints
Schema contract for standardized AI workflow output

assumptions.statement: Default onboarding target cohort is net-new workspaces with mixed technical proficiency.
Trust-critical primitives remain enabled system-wide even when not foregrounded in day-0 UX.
Feature-flag infrastructure supports cohort rollouts and sub-30-minute rollback.

constraints: No loss of trust-critical primitives; defer exposure only
Prefer reversible rollout and feature flags

decisions.title: Adopt dual-lane first run with fast default and optional governance lane
decisions.rationale: Most complexity perception appears before first collaboration event; dual-lane keeps momentum while preserving governance path.
alternatives_considered: Single long wizard with all controls exposed
Hard split product editions at signup
decisions.user_impact: New users can create a workspace, room, invite, and first thread/call in one guided path under 10 minutes.

decisions.title: Hide advanced governance/stego/federation behind admin-only expansion points
decisions.rationale: Exposure sequencing reduces cognitive load while RBAC preserves access integrity.
alternatives_considered: Remove advanced settings from starter deployments
decisions.user_impact: Members see cleaner navigation; admins still retain full advanced controls via explicit expansion surfaces.

decisions.title: Ship lifecycle progressive disclosure at Day 0, Day 7, Day 30
decisions.rationale: Maturity-based reveal aligns complexity to organizational readiness.
decisions.user_impact: New teams stay focused on immediate collaboration, then grow into governance and sovereignty workflows.

decisions.title: Operational packaging into starter/governance/sovereignty tiers
decisions.rationale: Broader team fit requires clear packaging while preserving the same primitive set.
decisions.user_impact: Pragmatic teams can start with low admin overhead; advanced organizations can expand without migration shock.

now.reason: Core mechanism to hit <10 minute TTFV.

now.name: Simplified global nav
now.reason: Reduces orientation overhead and aligns with Discord-like expectations.

now.name: Advanced governance controls in admin expansion
Onboarding funnel instrumentation
now.reason: Needed to prove complexity reduction outcomes.

next.reason: Requires baseline usage signals and cohort telemetry first.

next.name: Preset room templates by team type
next.reason: Improves setup quality after core flow stabilization.

next.name: Admin trust setup checklist
next.reason: Bridges first value to trust maturity workflows.

deferred_or_killed.name: Expose full advanced settings during first run
Remove trust-critical controls from starter packaging
deferred_or_killed.reason: Violates trust and sovereignty integrity constraints.

onboarding_flow.name: Create or join workspace
onboarding_flow.goal: Land user in active workspace shell with minimal required inputs.
onboarding_flow.success_metric: 85% of starts complete step within 2.5 minutes

onboarding_flow.name: Create first room
onboarding_flow.goal: Ensure immediate collaboration space exists through one-click preset.
onboarding_flow.success_metric: 80% of completed step-1 users create at least one room

onboarding_flow.name: Invite members
onboarding_flow.goal: Trigger multi-user value by sending at least one invite or scheduling reminder.

onboarding_flow.name: Start first thread or call
onboarding_flow.goal: Produce first collaborative event that defines time-to-first-value.
onboarding_flow.success_metric: 60% start first thread or call; median cumulative time < 10 minutes

navigation_changes.change: Consolidate to Home, Rooms, DMs, Activity, Calls, and role-based Admin entry.
navigation_changes.complexity_reduction_reason: Fewer top-level choices reduce orientation latency and decision fatigue.

navigation_changes.change: Collapse Governance, Stego, Federation, and advanced key controls into an explicit Advanced panel.
navigation_changes.complexity_reduction_reason: Protects novice users from high-stakes controls while preserving admin discoverability.

navigation_changes.change: Show templates first; move metadata and policy tuning under Customize (optional).
navigation_changes.complexity_reduction_reason: Prevents optional fields from blocking first-value action.

day_0: Admin quick settings (workspace name/logo/invite policy preset)

microcopy.plain_language_copy: Set decision rules so your workspace stays fair, auditable, and predictable.
Add optional hidden-signal protections for high-sensitivity coordination.
Choose which outside servers your team can connect to and under what boundaries.
Keep control of infrastructure, data location, and policy authority with your organization.
Define how encryption keys rotate, recover, and are audited over time.
Review tamper-evident records of sensitive admin and governance actions.
Preview who is affected by a rule before enforcing it across the workspace.
Limit high-risk permissions to reduce accidental or unauthorized changes.
Set how long data is kept to match legal, operational, and trust requirements.
Connect partner communities while preserving explicit trust boundaries and policy controls.

complexity_pain_points.description: Too many first-run choices before any collaboration outcome.
complexity_pain_points.proposed_fix: Enforce guided 4-step onboarding with skip-safe defaults.

complexity_pain_points.description: Advanced governance controls surfaced to non-admin members.
complexity_pain_points.proposed_fix: Apply RBAC visibility and admin expansion points.

complexity_pain_points.description: Room creation requires optional metadata too early.
complexity_pain_points.proposed_fix: Template-first room creation and deferred customization.

complexity_pain_points.description: Invite paths are fragmented across methods and surfaces.
complexity_pain_points.proposed_fix: Unified invite modal with prioritized method ordering.

complexity_pain_points.description: Weak post-setup prompt to initiate first thread or call.
complexity_pain_points.proposed_fix: Mandatory completion step prompting thread/call kickoff.

complexity_pain_points.description: Security terminology is opaque for first-time users.
complexity_pain_points.proposed_fix: Use one-line plain language plus optional deep links.

complexity_pain_points.description: Settings taxonomy is deep and inconsistent.
complexity_pain_points.proposed_fix: Flatten IA and unify grouping for user/admin/advanced layers.

complexity_pain_points.description: No lifecycle-based guidance for governance maturity.
complexity_pain_points.proposed_fix: Day-7 and Day-30 nudges with eligibility triggers.

complexity_pain_points.description: Mobile and web onboarding parity is inconsistent.
complexity_pain_points.proposed_fix: Shared onboarding contract and parity acceptance tests.

complexity_pain_points.description: Funnel instrumentation is incomplete for diagnosing drop-off.
complexity_pain_points.proposed_fix: Implement required telemetry schema and step-level dashboards.

tiers.name: starter
tiers.ideal_customer_profile: Pragmatic teams prioritizing quick collaboration with low admin overhead.
tiers.security_posture_summary: Trust-critical primitives active by default, with advanced controls deferred.

tiers.name: governance
tiers.ideal_customer_profile: Co-ops, activist orgs, and policy-sensitive teams requiring stronger governance workflow controls.
tiers.security_posture_summary: Adds policy controls and stronger audit operations while retaining simple member UX.

tiers.name: sovereignty
tiers.ideal_customer_profile: Organizations requiring full infrastructure sovereignty and federation policy depth.
tiers.security_posture_summary: Full sovereignty/federation control with advanced key and policy lifecycle tooling.

not_fit_rules.rule: Not fit for organizations requiring immediate custom federation topology editing on day 0.
not_fit_rules.reason: Starter intentionally defers advanced sovereignty exposure to reduce first-run complexity.

not_fit_rules.rule: Not fit where policy mandates full self-hosted key custody from initial deployment.
not_fit_rules.reason: Requires sovereignty tier controls and deployment model.

feature_flags.name: ff_onboarding_wizard_v2
feature_flags.rollback_strategy: Disable flag to restore legacy onboarding path instantly.

feature_flags.name: ff_nav_simplification_v1
feature_flags.rollback_strategy: Re-enable legacy nav schema while preserving admin deep links.

feature_flags.name: ff_admin_advanced_expansion_v1
feature_flags.rollback_strategy: Promote advanced items to direct admin menu if discoverability regresses.

feature_flags.name: ff_lifecycle_disclosure_v1
feature_flags.rollback_strategy: Turn off timed nudges and fall back to static admin checklist.

feature_flags.name: ff_onboarding_telemetry_v1
feature_flags.rollback_strategy: Disable only non-essential events; keep compliance-critical audit events active.

compatibility.rule: Legacy deep links to governance routes must remain valid for admins.
compatibility.migration_action: Add context banner and redirect to new admin advanced panel.

compatibility.rule: Existing workspaces keep prior default room structures unless admin opts into templates.
compatibility.migration_action: Feature flag by workspace creation date and cohort.

rollbacks.trigger: Median TTFV worsens by >15% for two consecutive days after launch
rollbacks.action: Disable ff_onboarding_wizard_v2 and restore legacy onboarding path.

rollbacks.trigger: Admin advanced feature discovery drops below alert threshold
rollbacks.action: Expand admin panel by default while maintaining member-level hiding.

rollbacks.trigger: Security or governance integrity regression detected
rollbacks.action: Freeze rollout cohort, disable UX flags, run incident response and verification checklist.

telemetry_events.description: User reaches first value completion state.

kpis.name: Admin advanced discovery rate by day 30
Settings confusion ticket rate per 1000 new workspaces

metrics.dashboard_notes: Dashboard should segment by tier, role, and client surface (web/desktop/mobile), with daily alerting for TTFV and completion regressions.

criteria: Median TTFV under 10 minutes in pilot

gates.name: Go-live gate: trust integrity

objectives: Finalize IA decisions and success criteria

objectives: Move advanced controls to admin expansions

objectives: Pilot rollout to 10-20% of new workspaces

risks.description: Governance-heavy users may perceive hidden controls as reduced capability.
risks.mitigation: Add contextual banners, deep-link continuity, and admin discoverability prompts.

risks.description: Lifecycle timing may not align with all organizational maturity curves.
risks.mitigation: Use signal-based triggers alongside time-based defaults and allow admin override.

risks.description: Insufficient telemetry quality can mask real complexity bottlenecks.
risks.mitigation: Implement schema validation, freshness SLA, and event completeness audits.

risks.description: Any RBAC regression could expose sensitive controls to non-admin users.
risks.mitigation: Automated RBAC gating tests in CI and launch gates requiring pass status.

what_got_simpler: First run is reduced to four essential actions with optional depth deferred.
Global navigation is flatter and role-aware.
Room creation and invites are template-first with fewer mandatory decisions.
what_got_safer: Trust-critical primitives remain enabled and admin-accessible.
Advanced surfaces are RBAC-gated and auditable.
Rollout is feature-flagged with explicit rollback triggers.

kpi_trends.interpretation: Improving toward target; maintain wizard and invite flow tuning.
Higher completion indicates reduced first-run complexity.

kpi_trends.kpi_name: Admin advanced discovery rate by day 30
kpi_trends.interpretation: Discovery is stable in governance tier but lagging in starter upgrades.
